cases.name: Alexandria Lynn Zurcher Reynolds
cases.about: Her obituary says, "She worked at Nordstrom in Elizabethtown. Alex loved spending time with her son. She enjoyed shopping for Coach purses and Nike shoes, and listening to classic rock and rap. She adored her Pitbull Suka, and her cat. Alex was deeply loved by her father, her son, and her friends; she will be greatly missed. She was a beautiful person, inside and out."
cases.narrative:
She had 2 black eyes and a laceration on her nose. He admitted to police he punched her in the head and face and kicked her while she was on the ground. He also stated he physically assaulted her the night prior. The deputy coroner also noted that Reynolds appeared to have been placed in the bathtub, and her face appeared to be “glistening, as if it had been recently washed.”

cases.name: Victoria Elizabeth Grieb Preston
cases.about: She formerly served in the U.S. Navy. Victoria was born in Mineola, NY and worked as a DJ.
cases.narrative:
He killed her with toxic levels of fentanyl and other medications, then set their house on fire, committing suicide.

'After his wife was dead, David Preston ignited a flammable substance “on and around his body and throughout the residence,” starting that fire that caused his own death from “extensive smoke and thermal injuries, both internal and external,” Northwest Regional Police Department said in a news release Thursday.

Detective Frank Ember Jr. confirmed that the investigation determined David Preston killed his wife with prescription drugs before setting the fire.'
